accepted_findings: scripts/verify.sh delegates to the same versioned PowerShell profile used by scripts/verify.ps1, so their ordered step list is identical by construction.
The profile fails closed on missing scripts and non-zero native exit codes.
Before W0-03 integration the profile intentionally could not pass because its STU step was a ContractChallenge.
conflicts_at_audit_time: Fast CI had an inline default-member command list and did not call the local versioned profile.
Local profile and CI differed on --locked and workspace scope.
Justfile retained a distinct quick inner loop; canonical I18.21 says scripts/Justfile are aliases around the versioned verifier/runner.
The separately authored PowerShell and Bash normative verifiers have edge-case parser differences even though both passed the current manifest.
result.post_audit_note: W0-03 subsequently changed fast CI to invoke scripts/verify.ps1 and aligned --locked/workspace flags. Full runtime parity remains unverified.

accepted_findings: OS entrypoints share one profile implementation.
CI/local structural parity required repair and has not yet been runtime-proved.
deferred: Do not claim full I18.21 conformance until the native verifier/runner bootstrap and tool identity/evidence model are reconciled.
Do not remove the repository's documented quick inner loop merely to satisfy a textual alias interpretation.
integration_disposition.proof_ceiling: static profile/workflow audit; no full verifier execution
